en: Then Nara taking up a handful of blades of grass said, 'Come and fight, O you Kshatriya, desirous of fight as you are; take up all your arms and prepare your army. I shall destroy your thirst for war from this moment forward.'

sa: प्रविश्य च गृहं राजन्नभ्यन्तरमरिंदम। गान्धारीसहितं वीरो धृतराष्ट्रं ददर्श सः॥ पुत्रवच्च नरव्याघ्र पादौ जग्राह धर्मवित्। धृतराष्ट्रेण चाश्लिष्य प्रेम्णा चापि विसर्जितः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, then entering the palace, that hero saw Dhritarashtra and Gandhari. O foremost of men, that virtuous one then took hold of their feet as one of their sons. He was first embraced affectionately by Dhritarashtra and was then dismissed.

sa: त्रयस्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि योजनानि हिरण्मयः। मेरुः पर्वतराट् यत्र देवोद्यानानि मुद्गल॥ नन्दनादीनि पुण्यानि विहाराः पुण्यकर्मणाम्। न क्षुत्पिपासे न ग्लानिर्न शीतोष्णे भयं तथा॥
en: There is that foremost of mountains, the golden Meru extending thirty-three thousand Yojanas. O Mudgala, there are also the celestial gardens. With Nandan at their head here sport the persons of meritorious acts. Neither hunger nor thirst nor heat or cold nor fear.

sa: विराट उवाच ददामि यानानि धनं निवेशनं ममाश्वसूतो भवितुं त्वमर्हसि। कुतोऽसि कस्यासि कथं त्वमागतः प्रब्रूहि शिल्पं तव विद्यते च यत्॥
en: Virata said I give you vehicles, wealth and quarters; you deserve to be the keeper of my horses. But tell me whence you are come, whose you are, and how you came here, also tell me of the arts you are versed with.

sa: ततः संतप्तहृदयः स्मरन्निग्रहमात्मनः। विनिःश्वस्य विनिःश्वस्य कृतवैरो महात्मना॥ स दक्षिणां दिशं गत्वा महिष्या सह राघव। तताप परमं घोरं विश्वामित्रो महातपाः॥
en: Then with his heart burning, in consequence of the remembrance of his humiliation, and having made enemies with that high-souled one, Viśvāmitra of mighty asceticism sighing and sighing, went towards the south, in company with his queen, and became engaged in dreadful austerities.

sa: ततो न्यग्रोधमासाद्य महान्तं हरितच्छदम्। परीतं बहुभिर्वृक्षैः श्यामं सिद्धोपसेवितम्॥ तस्मिन् सीताञ्जलिं कृत्वा प्रयुञ्जीताशिषां क्रियाम्। समासाद्य च तं वृक्षं वसेद् वातिक्रमेत वा।७।। क्रोशमात्रं ततो गत्वा नीलं प्रेक्ष्य च काननम्। सल्लकीबदरीमिश्रं रम्यं वन्यैश्च यामुनैः॥
en: Next coming to a gigantic banian tree with green foliage, named śyāma, surrounded by various trees and inhabited by ascetics of accomplished purposes, let Şītā with joined hands offer humble supplications to it. Having come to the tree and, whether staying under it or proceeding along, after passing only a Krosa, you will, O Rama, see a wood abounding in Sallakis, Badaris, and other wild trees belonging to the Yamuna.

sa: प्रवर्यं शास्त्रतः कृत्वा तथैवोपसदं द्विजाः। चक्रुश्च विधिवत् सर्वमधिकं कर्म शास्त्रतः॥ अभिपूज्य तदा हृष्टाः सर्वे चक्रुर्यथाविधि। प्रातः सवनपूर्वाणि कर्माणि मुनिपुङ्गवाः॥
en: And the regenerate ones, having performed the pravargya as well as the upasada according to the ordinance, duly completed the additional ceremonies. Then, worshipping the deities with glad hearts, those foremost of ascetics duly performed the morning ablutions and the other prescribed rites.

sa: इति पुत्रस्य शेषाश्च कृत्वा शिरसि भामिनी। गन्धैश्चापि समालभ्य राममायतलोचना॥ औषधी च सुसिद्धार्था विशल्यकरणीं शुभाम्। चकार रक्षां कौसल्या मन्त्रैरभिजजाप च॥
en: Saying this Kausalyā, the foremost of all women, having expansive eyes, placed the grains on Rāma's head; sprinkled his body with fragrant substances, and tied to his hands, as amulet, twigs of such auspicious plants as Viśalyakaraṇī, with due mental repetition of mantras.

sa: क्षुधितस्य च सिंहस्य मृगशत्रोस्तरस्विनः। आशीविषस्य वदनाद् दंष्ट्रामादातुमिच्छसि॥ मन्दरं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं पाणिना हर्तुमिच्छसि। कालकूटं विषं पीत्वा स्वस्तिमान् गन्तुमिच्छसि॥ अक्षि सूच्या प्रमृजसि जिह्वया लेढि च क्षुरम्। राघवस्य प्रियां भार्यामधिगन्तुं त्वमिच्छसि॥
en: Do you wish to uproot the teeth from the mouth of a lion, that enemy of deer, or from that of a serpent? Do you wish to clasp with your hands the Mandara hill, or do you wish to walk in peace after drinking poison? Do you wish to rub your eyes with pins and lick a razor with your tongue?

sa: गतो दशरथः स्वर्गं यो नो गुरुतरो गुरुः। रामं प्रव्राज्य वै ज्येष्ठं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्॥ त्वमद्य भव नो राजा राजपुत्र महायशः। संगत्या नापराध्नोति राज्यमेतदनायकम्॥...
en: Having exiled his eldest son and the exceedingly strong Lakşmaņa, Dasaratha who was the superior of our superiors has gone to heaven. Do you, therefore, O illustrious prince, become our king. Having been permitted by the king you will commit no fault (by doing so), as this kingdom is without a master.

sa: स निश्चितां मतिं कृत्वा यष्टव्यमिति बुद्धिमान्। मन्त्रिभिः सह धर्मात्मा सर्वैरपि कृतात्मभिः॥ ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजाः सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रिसत्तम। शीघ्रमानय मे सर्वान् गुरूंस्तान् सपुरोहितान्॥
en: That highly-energetic, pious and intelligent monarch, in consultation with all his counsellors of sedate minds, having made up his mind to celebrate the sacrifice, said to that best of counsellors, Sumantra, Do you speedily summon my spiritual guides, along with the family priests.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु राजा कैकेय्या वाक्यं परमशोभनम्। रामस्य च वने वासमैश्वर्यं भरतस्य च।११।। नाभ्यभाषत कैकयी मुहूर्तं व्याकुलेन्द्रियः। प्रेक्षतानिमिषो देवीं प्रियामप्रियवादिनीम्॥
en: The king with his senses overwhelmed with grief, hearing Kaikeyi's exceedingly bitter words, reflected on Rama's abode in the woods, and the advancement of Bharata, and being bewildered for a while spoke not to Kaikeyi but gazed steadfastly at that exalted dame. a

sa: पपात स द्विजस्तत्र निगूढे सलिलाशये।॥ विलग्नश्चाभवत् तस्मिन् लतासंतानसंकुले। पनसस्य यथा जातं वृन्तवद्धं महाफलम्॥ स तथा लम्बते तत्र रार्ध्वपादो ह्यधःशिराः।
en: While wandering the Brahmana dropped into that invisible pit. He was entangled in those creepers that were interwoven with one another, like the large fruit of a jack tree hanging by its stalk. He remained there hanging with feet upwards and head downwards.

sa: एतां बुद्धिमहं प्राप्य न प्रहृष्ये न च व्यथे॥ यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महोदधौ। समेत्य च व्यपेयातां तद्वद्भूतसमागमः॥
en: Having gained such an understanding, I do not give way to joy or to grief. As two pieces of wood floating on the sea meet together at one time and are again separated, so is the union of (living) creatures in this world.

sa: अत्र पिङ्गलया गीता गाथाः श्रूयन्ति पार्थिव। यथा सा कृच्छ्रकालेऽपि लेभे धर्मं सनातनम्॥
en: About it, O king, are heard the verses sung by Pingala regarding the way in which she had acquired eternal inerit even at a very unfavourable time.

sa: रथिनः कुञ्जरानश्वान् पदातींश्चापि मज्जतः। दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनः क्षिप्रमुपायात् तममर्षितः॥
en: Then beholding his car-warriors, his elephants, his steeds and foot-soldiers, smashed, the enraged Duryodhana quickly rushed at Abhimanyu.

sa: भृगुरुवाच घनानामपि वृक्षाणामाकाशोऽस्ति न संशयः। तेषां पुष्पफलव्यक्तिर्नित्यं समुपपद्यते॥
en: Bhrigu said Forsooth, though possessed of density, trees have space within them. They always bear flowers and fruits.

sa: अथ गां मधुपर्कं चाप्युदकं च जनार्दने। उपजह्वर्यथान्यायं धृतराष्ट्रपुरोहिताः॥
en: They, headed by Dhritarashtra, duly offered to Janardana, as was the custom, a cow, honey, curds and water.

sa: भीष्म उवाच स एवमुक्तो मान्धाता तेनोतथ्येन भारत। कृतवानविशङ्कश्च एकः प्राप च मेदिनीम्॥
en: Bhishma said nus spoken to by Utatthya, O Bharata, Mandhatri unhesitatingly did as he as he was directed, and became the soul king of the wide Earth.

sa: तैः समेत्य यथान्यायं कुरुभिः कुरुसंसदि। विदुरावसथं रम्यमुपातिष्ठत माधरः॥
en: Madhava, having exchanged greetings with the Kurus suitably in their assembly, went to the enchanting abode of Vidura.

sa: प्रवणादिव शैलानां शिखराणि द्विपोत्तमाः॥ सारोहा निहताः पेतुर्ववभिन्ना इवाद्रयः।
en: Resembling mountain summits, the best of elephants with their drivers slain, fell down like mountains clapped by thunderbolt.

sa: गन्धर्वराजो यो धीमान् धृतराष्ट्र इति श्रुतः। स एव मानुषे लोके धृतराष्ट्र: पतिस्तव॥
en: It is heard that he who was the intelligent kings of the Gandharvas and named Dhritarashtra, took birth in the world of men as your lord Dhritarashtra,

sa: विनष्टाः पाण्डवः कृष्णे शाश्वतं नरकं गता। पतिमन्यं वृणीष्वेति वदंस्त्वं गजसामिनीम्॥ उपप्रेक्षसि राधेय क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः।
en: When you spoke to the Princess Draupadi, of dignified elephantine gait, “O Draupadi, the Pandavas are lost into eternal hell, choose another husband" and looked on the scene with glee where was this virtue of yours?

sa: तालुदेशमथोद्दाल्य ब्राह्मणस्य महात्मनः। ज्योतिर्चाला सुमहती जगाम त्रिदिवं तदा॥
en: Then passing the crown of the great Brahmana a fiery flame of great effulgence went up to heaven,

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच वासुदेवो महद् भूतं सर्वलोकेषु कथ्यते। तस्यागमं प्रतिष्ठां च ज्ञातुमिच्छे पितामह॥
en: Duryodhana said In all the worlds, Vasudeva is spoken of as the Highest Being; O grandsire, I desire to know all about his nativity and his glory.

sa: अपक्रान्ते ततस्तस्मिन् द्रोणपुत्रे महारथे।॥ सहित रक्षिभिः सर्वैः प्राणेदुर्योषितस्तदा।
en: After Drona's son, that great car-warrior, had gone away, the women and all the guards began to bewail.

sa: गन्धः स्पृशो रसो रूपं शब्दश्चात्र गुणाः स्मृताः। तस्य गन्धस्य वक्ष्यामि विस्तराभिहितान् गुणान्॥
en: Scent, touch, taste, vision and sound, are considered as the common properties of all mobile and immobile objects. I shall first describe the several sorts of scent.

sa: पदातीनां सहस्रं च सादिनां च परंतप। भोज्यं च विपुलं राजन् प्रेष्याच शतशोऽपरे॥
en: A thousand foot-soldiers and a thousand horsemen too (followed him) O chastiser of foes; as also hurdreds of others carrying sufficient provision and other things. one was

sa: तस्मिन् प्रतिवसन्तस्ते यत् प्रापुः कुरुसत्तमाः। वने क्लेशं सुखोदकं तत् प्रवक्ष्यामि ते शृणु॥
en: I will now tell you of the trouble, which those most exalted of the Kurus went through and which led to their ultimate happiness. Listen to it.

sa: तावुभौ धर्मराजस्य प्रवीरौ परिपार्श्वतः। स्थाभ्याशे चकाशेते चन्द्रस्येव पुनर्वसू॥
en: Each of those heroes stood by Yudhishthira shining like the constellation Punarvasu by the side of the moon.

sa: पराशर उवाच वृत्तिः सकाशाद् वर्णेभ्यस्त्रिभ्यो हीनस्य शोभना। प्रीत्योपनीता निर्दिष्टा धर्मिष्ठान् कुरुते सदा॥
en: Parashara said The lowest order, it is proper, should derive their maintenance from the three other orders. Such service, rendered with love and respect, makes them pious.

sa: भवेयमिति संचिन्त्य ब्राह्मणं तं नमस्य च। कौतूहलात् तु तं लब्ध्वा बालिश्यादाचरं तदा। कन्या सती देवमर्कमासादयमहं ततः॥
en: And thinking of that Brahmana and bowing to him in my mind out of curiosity and behaving as a child at the time I came in contact with the god Surya though yet an unmarried girl.

sa: श्रान्ताः प्रसुप्तास्तत्रेमे मात्रा सह सुदुःखिताः। सुप्तांश्चैनानभ्यगच्छद्धिडिम्बा नाम राक्षसी॥
en: Fatigued and distressed they fell asleep with their mother. A Rakshasas woman, named Hidimba then came to them.

sa: यत्राबलो वध्यमानस्त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति। महान् दैवकृतस्तत्र दण्डः पतति दारुणः॥
en: When a Weak person fails to find a protector the great rod of divine punishment overtakes the king.

sa: ज्योतिराकाशमादित्यो वायुरिन्द्रः प्रजापतिः। नोपैति यावदध्यात्म तावदेतान् न पश्यति॥
en: Light, ether, sun, wind, Indra, and Prajapati, one sees these as long as one does not acquire Adhyatma.

sa: आज्ञां तु शिरसा बिभ्रदेष गच्छामि मा शुचः। समेत्य तान् नरव्याघ्रांस्तव दास्यामि संविदम्॥
en: However, placing your command on my head, behold, I proceed. do not give way to grief. Returning, I shall bring you intelligence of those foremost of men.

sa: ततस्तेषामनुमते तद् विप्रैस्तु नराधिपः॥ सत्रं समापयामास ऋत्विग्भिपरैः सह।
en: Thereupon the king with the permission of the Ritvijas completed his sacrifices with the assistance of other Ritvijas.

sa: वृकोदरं समासाद्य संशयो वै जये हि नः। न्यायतो युध्यमानानां कृती ह्येष महाबलः॥
en: If Duryodhana meets Vrikodara amongst us wishing to fight fairly with him, even then our victory will hang in the balance. Duryodhana is highly powerful and skillful.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच पञ्चभिर्यदि भूतैस्तु युक्ताः स्थावरजङ्गमाः। स्थावराणां न दृश्यन्ते शरीरे पञ्च धातवः॥
en: Bharadwaja said If all mobile and immobile objects be made of these five elements, why is it that in all immobile objects those elements are not seen.

sa: तथैव तान् निपतितानपिंघन् गजवाजिनः। तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने रक्षांसि पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: While the camp was in this state of confusion, Rakshasas, O king, cried aloud in joy, O Bharata-chief.

sa: धनुरादाय तत्राहं नाशकं तस्य पूरणे॥ यथा पुरा च मे वीर्यं भुजयोर्न तथाऽभवत्।
en: Taking up my bow, I found myself unequal to even string it. The power that had existed in my arms seemed to have disappeared on that occasion.

sa: कृपश्च सोमदत्तश्च महाराजश्च बाह्निकः। आसनेभ्योऽचलन् सर्वे पूजयन्तो जनार्दनम्॥
en: So also Kripa, Somadatta and the great king Balhika stood up from their respective seats for worshipping Janardana.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच असैनिका धर्मपराश्च धर्म परां गतिं न नयन्ते ह्ययुक्तम्। क्षात्रो धर्मो ह्यादिदेवात्प्रवृत्तः पश्चादन्ये शेषभूताश्च धर्माः॥
en: Indra said Those who are not kings, even if then satisfy their duties, cannot easily attain the highest meed of duty. Kingly duties first emanated from the original god. Other duties sprang afterwards from his body.

sa: शरीरमेवायतनं सुखस्य दुःखस्य चाप्यायतनं शरीरम्। यद्यच्छरीरेण करोति कर्म तेनैव देही समुपाश्नुते तत्।।
en: The body is the abode of both sorrow and happiness. An embodied creature suffers the consequences of whatever acts he performs with the help of his body.

sa: नाधिज्यमपि यच्छक्यं कर्तुमन्येन गाण्डिवम्। अन्यत्रार्जुनभीमाभ्यां त्वया वा मधुसूदन॥
en: O slayer of Madhu, fie to the Gandiva, which none else can string except Arjuna; Bhima and yourself!

sa: एतदिच्छामि भद्रं ते श्रोतुं धर्मभृतां वर। त्वत्तो महामते व्याध तद् ब्रवीहि यथातथम्॥
en: O best of virtuous persons, you are blessed! I desire to hear this from you. O lofty-minded one, O Fowler, tell me the details of it truly.

sa: मम तेजो बलं भीमं वायोरपि हि नारद। कलामष्टादशी प्राणैर्न मे प्राप्नोति मारुतः॥
en: My terrific energy and power, O Narada, are the greater than the Wind's. In sooth, the strength of the Wind is only an eighteenth part of mine.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सोऽच्युतायुर्महारथः। शूलेन भृशतीक्ष्णेन ताडयामास पाण्डवम्॥
en: At this crisis that mighty car-warrior Achyutayusha struck the son of Pandu with a trident of exceeding sharpness.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा पुनरायान्तं रथेन रथिनां वरम्॥ घटोत्कचमसम्भ्रान्तं राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतम्।
en: Beholding then that foremost of carwarriors viz., Ghatotkacha, dauntlessly approach him surrounded by a large number of Rakshasa.

sa: यस्य दिव्यानि कर्माणि प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः। तान्यहं कीर्तयिष्यामिभक्त्या स्थैर्यार्थमात्मनः॥
en: His divine achievements are extolled by the wise; I shall also recite them with reverence, regaining my equanimity.

sa: श्रुत्वा चैवं मयोक्तास्तु भीष्मद्रोणकृपास्तदा। ज्ञातिक्षयभयाद् राजन् भीतेन भरतर्षभ॥ ततः स्थास्यन्ति समये पाण्डवा इति मे मतिः। समुच्छेदं हि नः कृत्स्नं वासुदेवश्चिकीर्षति॥
en: Then were Bhishma, Drona and Kripa thus addressed by me, who heard this, through fear of the ruin of our cousins, Oking, "That the sons of Pandu will abide by the terms agreed to, is my opinion; our destruction does the son of Vasudeva desire.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य भग्नं स्वबलमन्तिकात्॥ जवेनाभ्यपत् तूर्णं सर्वांश्चैको न्यवारयत्।
en: Beholding his own army thus routed he quickly rushed and assailed the victorious enemy, alone opposing them all.

sa: न कामकारः कामं वा तव राक्षसपुङ्गव। दैवं चेष्टयते सर्वं हतं दैवेन हन्यते॥
en: O foremost of the Rākşasas, forsooth this is not your own folly-it is Accident that unite all things and it is accident again that bring about destrucion.

sa: मन्ये न तावदात्मानं बुध्यते वानराधिपः। शैलप्रहाराभिहतः कुम्भकर्णेन संयुगे॥
en: Meseems, the lord of monkeys struck with dart in battle by Kumbhakarna has not yet recovered his senses.

sa: द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां हार्दिक्यो निजघान द्विधा तदा। सा छिन्ना पतिता भूमौ शक्तिः कनकभूषणा॥
en: The son of Hridika, he cut it in twain with a couple of arrows. That dart decked with golden ornaments, thus severed, fell down on the earth.

sa: आविशध्वं हयं क्षिप्रं दासी न स्यामहं यथा। नावपद्यन्त ये वाक्यं ताशशाप भुजंगमान्॥
en: And speedily cover the horse's tail so that she might not become a slave. But on their refusal to do her bidding. She cursed the snakes, saying,

sa: एतद् वै कीर्तनीयस्य सूर्यस्यामिततेजसः। नामाष्टशतकं चेदं प्रोक्तमेतत् स्वयंभुवा॥
en: These are the one hundred and eight names of immeasurably effulgent Surya as told by the self-created (Brahma).

sa: ते निवृत्ता महाकायाः श्रुत्वाङ्गदवचस्तदा। नैष्ठिकी बुद्धिमास्थाय सर्वे संग्रामकाङ्गिणः॥
en: Having desisted on hearing the words of Angada those huge-bodied ones, regaining calmness, became (again) intent on fight.

sa: तस्यैतत् क्रोधसंयुक्तमुक्तं श्रुत्वा वराङ्गना। कैकेयी द्विगुणं क्रुद्धा राजानमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing these wrathful words of the king, that beauteous one, Kaikeyi, waxing doubly wroth, addressed the monarch, saying.

sa: भेरीमृदङ्गपणवान् नादयन्तश्च पुष्करान्। पाण्डवा अभ्यवर्तन्त नदन्तो भैरवान् स्वान्॥
en: And with fierce yells, the Pandavas rushed to battle. With the sound of our drums, cyrnbals conchs, Dundubhis,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अहं ते राजशार्दूल कथयामि कथामिमाम्। पृच्छतो भरतश्रेष्ठ शुश्रूषस्व गिरं मम॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O best of kings, I will relate that history to you, as asked by you. O best of the Bharatas, listen to my words.

sa: नैमिषे वसतस्तस्य सर्व एव नराधिपाः। आनिन्युरुपहारांश्च तारामः प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: While he remained in the Naimisa forest, all the kings sent him presents and Rāma also made returns.

sa: नक्षत्राणि गताचींषि ग्रहाश्च गततेजसः। विशाखाश्च सधूमाश्च नभसि प्रचकाशिरे॥
en: The stars are shorn of their brightness; the Grahas deprived of sheen; and Viśākhā appeared enveloped in haze.

sa: ते द्रोणं सहिताः शूराः
en: and monarchs, rushed (into the thick of the fight).

sa: सहदेवस्तु विंशत्या धर्मराजश्च पञ्चभिः। शतेन नकुलश्चापि हार्दिक्यं समविध्यत॥
en: Then Sahadeva pierced Hridika's son with twenty, Yudhishthira the virtuous with five and Nakula with a hundred shafts.

sa: रन्तिदेवश्च सांकृत्यो वसिष्ठाय महात्मने। अy प्रदाय विधिवल्लेभे लोकाननुत्तमान्॥
en: Rantideva, the son of Sangakriti, attained to the highest heaven by duly making gifts to the great Vasishtha.

sa: ये चान्ये ऋतवस्तात ब्राह्मणैरभिपूजिताः। तैर्यजस्व महीपाल शक्रो देवपतिर्यथा॥
en: Like Shakra, the king of gods, O sire, perform those other sacrifices that are lauded by the Brahmanas!

sa: तांस्तथा पुरतो दृष्ट्वा सौबलस्य पदानुगान्॥ प्रत्युद्ययुर्महाराज पाण्डवा विजयोद्यता:।
en: Beholding those followers of Subala's son thus proceeding to battle, the victorious Pandavas, O monarch rushed against them.

sa: ते सान्त्व्य धौम्यं परिदीनसत्त्वाः सुखं भवानेत्विति राजपुत्राः। श्येना यथैवामिषसम्प्रयुक्ता जवेन तत् सैन्यमथाभ्यधावन्।॥
en: Then with hearts not depressed the princes, consoling Dhaumya said, "Go back cheerfully', then they rushed furiously towards that army like hawks swooping down on their prey.

sa: तस्मिन् समागमे सुभूः शर्मिष्ठाः चारुहासिनी। लेभे गर्भं प्रथमतस्तस्मानृपतिसत्तमात्॥
en: Sharmishtha of sweet smiles and fair eyebrows conceived in consequence of that connection with that best of kings.

sa: तार्क्ष्य उवाच इदं श्रेयः परमं मन्यमाना व्यायच्छन्ते मुनयः सम्प्रतीताः। आचक्ष्व मे तं परमं विशोकं मोक्षं परं यं प्रविशन्तिधीराः। सांख्या योगा परमं यं विदन्ति परं पुराणं तमहं न वेद्मि॥
en: O Goddess! kindly describe that supreme position of emancipation where is left no place for agony for which sake the great sages imposed due checks on their sensories and the people of high degree patience inter into. This is because that supreme position as perceived to the yogis having expertise in Samkhya and Karma. I am absolutely alien to that element of emancipation.

sa: महात्मानौ महाभागौ सर्वलक्षणलक्षितौ। तौ कदाचित् समेतानामृषीणां भावितात्मनाम्॥ मध्येसभं समीपस्थाविदं काव्यमगायताम्। तच्छुत्वा मुनयः सर्वे वाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणाः॥ साधु साध्विति तावूचुः परं विस्मयमागताः। ते प्रीतिमनसः सर्वे मुनयो धर्मवत्सला:॥
en: Once upon a time, those high-souled and pious ones, furnished with every auspicious mark, chanted this poem in an assembly of ascetics of purified souls. Having heard this music, all the ascetics were seized with surprise, and with eyes flooded with tears, exclaimed, Well done! Well done! And well pleased, those saints cherishing Duty.

sa: मन्दाकिन्यास्तु यदिदं रूपमेतन्मनोरमम्। स्थाने जगति विख्याता गुणास्तस्या मनोरमाः॥
en: Truly does this lake like to Mandākini itself, deserve the accomplishments that are known all over the world.

sa: ऊर्जितः खलु ते कामः कृतो मम गुरो सखे। यो मे त्वमीदृशीं सेनामभ्यर्चयितुमिच्छसि॥
en: Your great desire, O friend of my superior, is surely as good as attained; since you of mighty energy have set your heart on entertaining my army.

sa: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्य चाकार्यमेव च। अयथावत् प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी॥
en: Raja Intellect, O Partha, is that by which one imperfectly discerns right and wrong, and what ought to be done and what ought not to be done.

sa: स चापि सृष्टः पित्रा ते भीष्मस्यान्तकरः किल॥ शिखण्डी रक्षितस्तेन स च मृत्युर्महात्मनः।
en: Your father had begotten Sikhandin for the slaughter of Bhishma. As regards Arjuna he only protected your brother when he caused the death of the high-souled Bhishma.

sa: दुर्योधनस्ततो राजन्नभ्यभाषत दुर्मुखम्। एष दुर्मुख राधेयो भीमेन विरथीकृतः॥
en: King Duryodhana, O monarch, addressing Durmukha said-"O Durmukha yonder is the son of Radha rendered carless by Bhimasena!

sa: तेषां मनुजसिंहानां पञ्चानाममितौजसाम्। बभूव कृष्णा सर्वेषां पार्थानां वशवर्तिनी॥
en: Krishna (Draupadi) became obedient to all the five sons of Pritha, those five best men of immeasurable energy.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा स तु तान् वीरान् पुमान् विदुरचोदितः। तारयामास राजेन्द्र गङ्गां नावा नरर्षभान्॥
en: O king, having said this, the man sent by Vidura took those heroes, those best of man, to the other side of the Ganges on his boat.

sa: मृग उवाच काममन्युपरीता हि बुद्ध्या विरहिता अपि। वर्जयन्ति नृशंसानि पापेष्वपि रता नराः॥ न विधिं ग्रसते प्रज्ञा प्रज्ञां तु ग्रसते विधिः। विधिपर्यागतानान् प्राज्ञो न प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: The deer said: Even men, who are slaves of lust and anger, who are devoid of reason and who are ever sinful, never commit such a cruel act. Man's individual judgment does not prevail against the ordinance; the ordinance (always) prevails against individual judgment. The wise men never sanction anything discountenanced by the ordinance.

sa: तत्रेषूपलयन्त्राणि बलवन्ति महान्ति च। आगतं प्रतिसैन्यं तैस्तत्र प्रतिनिवार्यते॥
en: (At those gates) are powerful and large arms, stones, and engines, whereby a hostile host approaching, is opposed.

sa: अन्वजानाच्च स्वाहाया रूपान्यत्वं महामुनिः। अब्रवीच्च मुनीन् सर्वान् नापराध्यन्ति वै स्त्रियः॥ श्रुत्वा तु तत्त्वतस्तस्मात् ते पत्नीः सर्वतोऽत्यजन्
en: That great Rishi told the seven Rishis all about the transformation of Svaha (as their wives) and also told them that their wives are perfectly innocent. (Even) having heard this, the seven Rihsis abandoned their wives,

sa: विसर्जये त्वां सौमित्रे मा भूद्धर्मविपर्ययः। त्यागो वधो वा विहितः साधूनां ह्युभयं समम्॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, it is not proper to act against morality, I do therefore renounce you; for the pious hold that destruction and renunciation are all the same.

sa: ते प्रेरिता महाराज शल्येनाहवशोभिना। भीमसेनरथं प्राप्य समसज्जन्त वाजिनः॥
en: Thus urged by Shalya, the ornament of battle those horses, approaching the chariot of Bhimasena, mingled in battle.

sa: पूजितस्तव पुत्रैश्च सर्वयोधैश्च भारत। वपुषातिप्रजज्वाल मध्याह्न इव भास्करः॥
en: O Bharata, adored by your sons and all the warriors, his body shone brilliantly like the noon-day sun.

sa: सहस्रचित्यो राजर्षिः प्राणानिष्टान् महायशाः। ब्राह्मणार्थे परित्यज्य गतो लोकाननुत्तमान्॥
en: The celebrated Royal sage Sahasrachitta went to the blessed regions by sacrificing his dear life for a Brahmana.

sa: संजय उवाच एवं ब्रुवाणो बीभत्सुर्जयद्रथवधोत्सुकः। त्वरायुक्तो महाबाहुस्त्वत्सैन्यं समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, the mighty-armed Vibhatsu, intent on slaying Jayadratha, quickly rushed against the hostile troops.

sa: समन्ताद्योजनशतं विषयं चास्य दुर्मतेः। धक्ष्यते पांसुवर्षेण महता पाकशासनः।।।।।
en: Showering dust Indra shall destroy, to the extent of a hundred Yojana, the territory of this vicious king.

sa: अनुद्यूते च पार्थेन वध: कर्णस्य संश्रुतः। वधे त्वकुर्वन् यत्नं ते तस्य कर्णमुखास्तदा॥
en: And at the second game of dice Partha swore to do away with Karna. Though the carwarriors with Karna at their head tried (their utmost) to slay.

sa: संजय उवाच शृणु व्यूहस्य रचनामर्जुनश्च यथा गतः। परिवार्य नृपं स्वं संग्रामश्चाभवद् यथा॥
en: Sanjaya said Hear now of the arrangement of the army and how Arjuna came and how the battle was fought by both sides encircling their respective kings.

sa: न ते शक्यमनाख्यातुमापद्धर्मं तथाविधम्। त्वमेव नः कुले धर्मस्त्वं सत्यं त्वं परा गतिः॥
en: You shall not be able to reject it, learned as you are in the practices permitted in the time of distress. You are Virtue, you are Truth.

sa: इत्युक्तास्ते तदा राजन् विप्रलम्भप्रधर्षिताः। प्रत्यब्रुवंस्तान् मुनयो यत् तच्छृणु नराधिप॥ वृष्ण्यन्धकविनाशाय मुसलं घोरमायसम्। वासुदेवस्य दायादः साम्बोऽयं जनयिष्यति॥
en: Hear now, O king, what those ascetics, attempted to be thus imposed on, said, “This heir of Vasudeva, by name Shamba, will produce a dreadful iron bolt for the destruction of the Vrishnis and the Andhakas.

sa: इमे हि दिव्ये मणिकुण्डले मे देवाश्च यक्षाश्च महर्षयश्च। तैस्तैरुपायैरमहर्तुकामा श्छिद्रेषु नित्यं परितर्कयन्ति॥
en: These celestial ear-rings of mine, made of rich gems, are such that the celestials and Yakshas and great Rishis always watch for opportunities for taking them away.

sa: बीभत्सुरपि गीतेन स्वनृत्येन च पाण्डवः। विराटं तोषयामास सर्वाश्चान्तःपुरस्त्रियः॥
en: Bibhatsu, the son of Pandu, pleased Virata and all the ladies of the harem by singing and dancing.

sa: ततः कुन्ती सुतान् दृष्ट्वा सर्वास्तद्गतचेतसः। युधिष्ठिरमुवाचेदं वचनं सत्यवादिनी॥
en: Thereupon that truthful lady Kunti, seeing all his son's minds are in great anxiety, thus spoke to Yudhishthira.

sa: अर्जुनस्तु कटाक्षेण जिह्यं विप्रेक्ष्य पार्षतम्॥ सबाष्यंमतिनिःश्वस्य धिग्धिगित्येव चाब्रवीत्।
en: But Arjuna only casting side glances at Prisata's son and sighing and shedding copious tears said 'fie, fie.'

sa: स्थाल्यः कुम्भ्यः करम्भ्यश्च दधिपूर्णाः सुसंस्कृताः। यौवनस्थस्य गौरस्य कपित्थस्य सुगन्धिनः॥ ह्रदाः पूर्णा रसालस्य दनः श्वेतस्य चापरे। बभूवुः पायसस्यान्ये शर्कराणां च संचयाः॥
en: And there were pitchers and water-pots and cleaned vessels for churning curd, filled with the same. And there were tanks of savoury and yellow butter-milk, well-tempered. And there were tanks filled with Rasāla;* and others filled with milk, and with sugar. *A preparation of butter-milk.

sa: समन्तपञ्चके पुण्ये त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुते॥ अहं निधनमासाद्य लोकान् प्राप्स्यामि शाश्वतान्। ततो जनसहस्राणि बाष्पपूर्णानि मारिष॥ प्रलापं नृपतेः श्रुत्वा व्यद्रवन्त दिशो दश।
en: By dying upon the sacred field of Samantapanchaka, celebrated over the three worlds, I shall, forsooth, go to the blessed abode of eternity.'-Then, having heard these lamentations of the king, O sire, thousands of men, with eyes full of tears, fled away in all directions.

sa: अनेन हि तपस्तप्तं बलार्थममराधिप। षष्टिं वर्षसहस्राणि ब्रह्मा चास्मै वरं ददौ॥ महत्त्वं योगिनां चैव महामायत्वमेव च। महाबलत्वं च तथा तेजश्चाम्यं सुरेश्वर।॥
en: O king of the celestials, Vritra had practised, for full sixty thousand years, the severest penances for acquiring strength. Brahma gave him the boons he had prayed for, viz., the greatness that belongs to Yogins, large powers of illusion, enough of might, and superabundant energy.

sa: यदि निर्यातिता ते स्यात्सीता रामाय मैथिली। न नः स्याद्व्यसनं घोरमिदं मूलहरं महत्॥
en: Have you returned Sītā the daughter of the king of Mithilā to Råma, this mighty and dreadful disaster, destroying the very root, would not have befallen us.

sa: शर्मिष्ठोवाच अधर्मात् पाहि मां राजन् धर्मं च प्रतिपादय। त्वत्तोऽपत्यवती लोके चरेयं धर्ममुत्तमम्॥
en: Sharmishtha said : O king, save me from sin. Protect my virtue. Becoming a mother by you, let me perform the greatest pious act in the world.

sa: तस्मात् सर्वाणि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च। तस्मादन्नं विशिष्टं हि सर्वेभ्य इति विश्रुतम्॥
en: From sacrifice all mobile and immobile creatures take their birth. For this reason it has been heard by us that food is the foremost of all things.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच साङ्गा वेदा यथान्यायं येनाधीता महात्मना। यस्मिन् साक्षाद् धनुर्वेदो ह्रीनिषेवे प्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Thai high-souled person who had duly studied the Vedas and their auxiliaries, he who had mastered this entire science of arms and who possessed modesty.

sa: तं तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य ते पुत्राः सैनिकाश्च विशाम्पते। प्रहृष्टमनसो भूत्वा सिंहवद् व्यनदन् मुहुः॥
en: Beholding Satyaki then in that plight, your sons your troops, O ruler of men, became greatly delighted at heart and they began incessantly to roar like lions.

sa: स पृष्टो राजपुत्रेण रामेणामिततेजसा। आचचक्षे महातेजा राघवाय विभीषणः॥
en: Asked by the king's son Rāma of immeasurable prowess, the exceedingly energetic Vibhīşaņa spoke to Rāma, informing him.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च माद्रीपुत्रावुभावपि॥
en: Then king Yudhishthira and that son of Pandu, Bhimasena, and Nakula and Sahadeva the two sons of Madri,

sa: तद् यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः। भवत्याहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय॥
en: Therefore do you so order things that powerful and high-souled hero in conflict, may act as becomes himself.

sa: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते। अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्॥
en: Sattva Knowledge is that by which One Eternal Essence undivided in the divided is seen in all things.

sa: निवार्य च महाबाहुं कोपसंरक्तलोचनम्। पितरं समुपातिष्ठद् धृतराष्ट्रं कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Having pacified the mighty armed (Bhima) with eyes red in anger, the king (Yudhisthira) approached his sire Dhritarashtra.

sa: ततो नीलाम्बुदप्रख्यः प्रहस्तो नाम राक्षसः। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं शूरः सेनापतिस्तदा॥
en: Then that heroic general, the Rākşasa named Prahasta, possessing the splendour of sable clouds, submitted with joined hands.

sa: अधर्मेण जयं लब्ध्वा को न हृष्येत पण्डितः॥ यथा संहृष्यते पापः पाण्डुपुत्रो वृकोदरः।
en: What learned man would rejoice after having gained victory by such unfair means as that vile wretch, Vrikodara, the son of Pandu, is rejoicing himself in glee.

sa: तान् वै विमनसो दृष्ट्वा माद्रीपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ शरैरनेकसाहस्रर्वारयामास संयुगे।
en: Seeing them so dispirited the brave son of Madri, with many thousand arrows, opposed them in that battle.

sa: ततो हाहाकृतं सैन्यं तव सव जनाधिप। हतं स्म मेनिरे सर्वे तावकास्तं विशाम्पते॥
en: Thereupon all your forces, O lord of men, set up a loud wail. (And) all your partisans, O lord of the earth, thought him to be dead.

sa: स वृष्यमाणो बाणौधैरतिकायो महाबलः। अवध्यकवचः संख्ये राक्षसो नैव विव्यथे॥ न शशाक रुजं कर्तुं युधि तस्य नरोत्तमः।
en: And albeit showered with those arrows, that Raksasas, the mighty Atikāya-in that encounter was not pierced by them on account of his impenetrable mail; and that best of men failed to hurt him in the contest.

sa: अथ वृत्रस्य कौरव्य दृष्ट्वा शक्रमवस्थितम्। न सम्भ्रमो न भीः काचिदास्था वा समजायत॥
en: Seeing Indra stationed before him, you of Kuru's race, Vritra felt neither awe nor fear, nor was he disposed to collect all his energies for the battle.

sa: स विहाय इमं लोकं प्रविष्टो वरुणालयम्। शूलं निवेश्य लवणे वरं तस्मै न्यवेदयत्॥
en: And forsaking this world, he entered the region of Varuņa; and making over the dart to Lavana, communicated to him all about the boon he had obtained.

sa: स्वस्ति गोब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु लोकानां ये च सम्मताः। जयतां राघवो युद्धे पौलस्त्यान् रजनीचरान्॥ चक्रहस्ते यथा विष्णुः सर्वानसुरसत्तमान् ।
en: Welfare to those cows, and Brāhmanas, and those that are prized by the worlds! As the discus-handed Vişņu vanquished the foremost Asuras, may Rāghava rout in battle those rangers of the night, the progeny of Pulastya!

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यथा संशप्तकैः सार्धमर्जुनस्याभवद् रणः। अन्येषां च महीपानां पाण्डवैस्तद् ब्रवीहि मे॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Do you relate to me how the battle of Arjuna waged with the Samsaptakas and that of other lords of the earth with the Pandavas.

sa: स संनिपातस्तुमुलो घोररूपो विशाम्पते। आसीद् रौद्रो महाराज कर्णपाण्डवयोर्मधे॥
en: O monarch, that encounter between Bhima and Karna in battle became dreadful and the noise thereof was tremendous.

sa: शाकुन्तलं महात्मानं दौष्यन्ति भर पौरव। भर्तव्योऽयं त्वया यस्मादस्माकं वचनादपि॥ तस्माद् भवत्वयं नाम्ना भरतो नाम ते सुतः।
en: Therefore, O descendant of the Puru race, cherish your this high-souled son, born of Shakuntala. As you will cherish this child at our word, therefore, your this son will be known by the name of Bharata.

sa: पुरोहितं च कुशलं ये चान्ये द्विजसत्तमाः। तौ च तात महेष्वासौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: Do you likewise communicate the same to the priest and the other principal Brāhmaṇas; as also, my child, to those mighty bowmen, the brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

sa: भरतश्च महाबाहुरयोध्यां पालयिष्यति। सर्वकामैः पुनः श्रीमान् रामः संसाध्यतामिति॥
en: The mighty-armed Bharata will govern Ayodhyā. Therefore, do you furnish the auspicious Rāma with every object of enjoyment.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय सावित्र्या वचनं नृपः। प्रसादयामास पुनः क्षिप्रमेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: Markandeya said : The king then bowing assent to the words of Savitri and saying "be it so," pleased her again and said "may this soon happen."

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच विदितं भवतामेतद् यथा वृत्तः कुरुक्षयः॥ ममापराधात् तत् सर्वमनुज्ञातं च कौरवैः।
en: Dhritarashtra said You know how the destruction of Kurus has happened. All that was brought about by my fault, though the Kauravas approved of all my counsels.

sa: दृढबद्धकपाटानि महापरिघवन्ति च। चत्वारि विपुलान्यस्या द्वाराणि सुमहान्ति च॥
en: Her doors are firmly established and furnished with massy bolts. And she has four wide and giant gates.

sa: कृपं च सौमदत्तिं च द्रोणं च रथिनां वरम्। सिन्धुराजं तथा कर्णमवमन्यत पाण्डवान्॥
en: As also Kripa and Somadatta's son and that foremost of car-warriors viz., Drona and the ruler of the Sindhus and Karna, as partisans, Duryodhana disregards the Pandavas.

sa: मिथ्याभिगृनो हि नरः पापात्मा मोहमास्थितः। अयशः प्राप्नुयाद् घोरं महद् वा प्राप्नुयाद् भयम्॥३७
en: The person who hankers after the worldly desire leads a sinful life, and under the influence of deceptive knowledge, comes by either dire disgrace or grim calamity.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यमग्निर्ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा समागच्छन्नृणां वरम्। दिधक्षुः खाण्डवं दावं दाशार्हसहितं पुरा॥ महाबलं महाबाहुमजितं कुरुनन्दनम्। सोऽयं किं कर्म कौन्तेयः करिष्यति धनंजयः॥
en: Yudhishthira said What work will Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, perform, who is mighty, long armed, invincible, the foremost of men, and the joy of Kurus, and before whom formerly the fire-god, desirous of consuming the Khandava forest, appeared in the guise of a Brahmana.

sa: प्रथमं संस्थिता भार्या पतिं प्रेत्य प्रतीक्षते। पूर्वं मृतं च भर्तारं पश्चात् साध्व्यनुगच्छति॥
en: The wife, gone before (dying before her husband), waits for the spirit of her husband and if the husband goes before, the chaste wife soon follows him.

sa: ततः कर्कोटको नागः सान्त्वयन् नलमब्रवीत्। मया तेऽन्तर्हितं रूपं न त्वां विद्युर्जना इति॥
en: Thereupon the snake, Karkotaka, consoling him, spoke to Nala: "I have wrought this change of your beauty for the reason that the people will not recognise you."

sa: गुप्तः कुशिकपुत्रेण कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विदेहेषु वसत्यसौ॥
en: Protected by Kusika's son, that exhancer of Kausalyā's joy stay in Videha in company with his brother, Laksmana.15

sa: युधिष्ठिरं च ते सर्वे समुदैक्षन्त पार्थिवाः। किं नु वक्ष्यति धर्मज्ञ इति साचीकृताननाः॥
en: All the kings, turning their faces sideways, looked at Yudhisthira, learned in the precepts of morality, and they all became curious to learn what he would say,

sa: प्रत्युद्ययुर्महाराज गजानिव महागजाः। दुर्मुखो दुर्जयश्चैव तथा दुर्मर्षणो युवा॥
en: O mighty monarch, encountered them like so many elephants encountering their huge compeers. Durmukha, Durjaya, the youthful Durmarshana.

sa: भुक्त चिकित्सकस्यान्नं तदनं च पुरीषवत्। पुंश्चल्यन्नं च मूत्रं स्यात् कारुकानं च शोणितम्॥१४
en: He who takes food from a physician, takes but an excrement; the food of a harlot is like urine; that of a skilled mechanic is like blood.

sa: मम रोषप्रयुक्तानां विशिखानां बलं सुराः॥ द्रक्ष्यन्त्यद्य विमुक्तानाममर्षाद् दूरगामिनाम्।
en: To-day shall the celestials behold the power of my arrows coursing a long distance shot through my ire.

sa: तत् त्वां यदभिवक्ष्यामि तत् कुरुष्व महाबल। सम्भावना हि लोकस्य मम पार्थस्य चोभयोः॥
en: Thereupon, O mighty hero, do you perform what I say to you, viz., carry out the wishes of myself and of Arjuna and of all present here.

sa: एतेनाराधितो ब्रह्मा तपसा भावितात्मना। अस्त्राणि चाप्यवाप्तानि रिपवश्च पराजिताः॥
en: Having adored the pure-souled Brahma with austerities, he has obtained weapons, and has defeated his foes (in fight).

sa: तेषामनीकानि बहूनि गाढं व्यूढानि दृष्ट्वा बहुलध्वजानि। मत्स्यस्य पुत्रं द्विषतां निहन्ता वैराटिमामन्त्र्य ततोऽभ्युवाच॥
en: Beholding their army and various well arranged divisions as well as numberless flags, that destroyer of enemies, addressing the son of Virata, the king of Matsya's, said,

sa: तत्र भीमादयस्ते तु कुरवो याजकाश्च ये॥ रेमुः श्रुत्वा विचित्रां तां धनंजयकथं शुभाम्।
en: Bhimasena and the other Kurus, including the sacrificial priests, who heard of the agrecable triumphs of Arjuna in course of his following the horse, became highly pleased.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच न शशाक द्वितीयं सा प्रत्याख्यातुमनिन्दिता। तं वै द्विजातिप्रवरं तदा शापभयानृप॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then O king, afraid of being cursed by that foremost of the twice-born ones, that faultless girl could not refuse him a second time.

sa: कृष्णा तु द्रौपदी कृष्णं तिर्यक् सासूयमैक्षत। प्रतिजग्राह तस्यास्तं प्रणयं चापि केशिहा॥ सख्युः सखा हृषीकेशः साक्षादिव धनंजयः।
en: The princess Draupadi, however, looked angrily and askance at Krishna. The destroyer of Keshi, viz., Hrishikesha, approved of that mark of love (for his friend) which the princess of Panchala, who also was his friend, showed.

sa: स्वर्गस्था अपि ये केचित् तान् नमस्यन्ति देहिनः। ते तत्प्रसादाद् गच्छन्ति तेनादिष्टफलां गतिम्॥
en: The bodiless dwellers of heaven, itself bow to that Supreme God and through His favour they acquire those fruits and that end which he ordains for them.

sa: मत्तमातङ्गसंकाशा लोहिताक्षा विभीषणाः॥ कामवर्णजवा युक्ता बलवन्तः शतं हयाः।
en: The horses yoked thereto were stout mettled, of chequered complexion, fleet, of red eyed and like infuriate elephants.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीत् स्वयं द्रोणः क्वेदं पाण्डव गम्यते। ननु नाम रणे शत्रुमजित्वा न निवर्तसे॥
en: Thereupon Drona addressing Arjuna said "Where are you going, O son of Pandu? Is it not the fact that you never turn back without defeating your adversary?”

sa: असंशयं तेऽपि ममैव पुत्रा दुर्योधनस्तु मम देहात् प्रसूतः। स्वं वै देहं परहेतोस्त्यजोत को नु ब्रूयात् समतामन्ववेक्ष्य॥
en: There is no doubt they (the Pandavas) too are my sons, but Duryodhana has spring from my (own) body. Speaking partially how will you advise me to replace my own body for the sake of others?

sa: ततो मद्राधिपो दृष्ट्वा विसंज्ञं सूतनन्दनम्। अपोवाह रथेनाजौ कर्णमाहवशोभिनम्॥
en: Beholding the Suta's son insensible the king of Madras carried him away on his car from the battle-field.

sa: न च तं कृष्ण पश्यामि क्षत्रधर्ममनुष्ठितम्। उत्सहेत युधा जेतुं यो नः शत्रुनिबर्हण॥
en: I do not see any body, O Krishna, following the duties of a Kshatriya who would i aspire to defeat us in battle, O chastiser of foes.

sa: जेतव्यमिति काकुत्स्थो मर्तव्यमिति रावणः। धृतौ स्ववीर्यसर्वस्वं युद्धेऽदर्शयतां तदा॥
en: And determining that Käkutstha would win victory and Răvana would died, they began to display their own prowess.

sa: शम्बरो देवराजेन नरको विष्णुना यथा । तथाद्य शयिता रामो मया युधि निपातितः॥
en: As Sambara was vanquished by the lord of the immortals, or Naraka by Visnu, will I bringing down Rāma in battle make him sleep (in the field).

sa: उल्काशनियुता मेघा बभूवुर्गर्दभारुणाः। ससागरवना चैव वसुधा समकम्पत ॥
en: Clouds containing meteors and lightning looked dark like asses. And the earth shook with her oceans and woods.

sa: जगर्जुश्च प्रणेदुश्च चिक्षिपुश्चापि सायकान्॥ जगृहुश्च महात्मानो निर्याता युद्धदुर्मदाः।
en: Those high-souled ones, incapable of being repressed in fight, roared and shouted and discharged shafts and held them,

sa: यथा शरदि मेघानां सिञ्चतामपि गर्जताम्। न भवत्यम्बुसंक्लेदस्तथानार्येषु सौहृदम्॥
en: As the autumnal clouds, albeit muttering, do not pour forth water, so is the friendship with unworthy persons.

sa: अद्य मद्वाणनिर्भग्नैर्मकरैर्मकरालयम्॥ निरुद्धतोयं सौमित्रे प्लवद्भिः पश्य सर्वतः। भोगिनां पश्य भोगानि मया भिन्नानि लक्ष्मण ॥ महाभोगानि मत्स्यानां करिणां च करानिह ।
en: See, O Sumitrā's son, the abode of Makaras, with his waters obstructed all around with Makaras destroyed by my shafts. O Laksmana, see the bodies here of serpents, and the huge on bodies of mighty fishes, and the trunks of elephants, torn by my arrows.

sa: मुश्च मां साधु धर्मज्ञ यावदेनं निहन्म्यहम्। नहि कश्चिन्मया दृष्टो बलवानपि जीवति ॥
en: Let me go. O you cognisant of righteousness, I shall slay this one. There is none that, albeit strong, can survive after having been seen by me.

sa: ततश्चिक्षेप शैलाग्रं नीलत्रिशिरसे तदा॥ तद्रावणसुतो धीमान्बिभेद निशितैः शरैः।
en: Then Nila hurled a mountain-top at Trisiras; and thereat that son of Rāvaņa severed it with sharpened arrows.

sa: प्रिये त्वं सह नारीणां वानराणां महात्मनाम्। राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता मैथिलीप्रियकाम्यया॥ त्वर त्वमभिगच्छामो गृह्य वानरयोषितः। अयोध्यां दर्शयिष्यामः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः॥
en: O dear, at the command of Rāghava and the kind desire of Sītā, do you soon go, taking with you the wives of all the high-souled monkeys. We shall see Ayodhyā and the wives of Dasaratha.

sa: स तस्य पततः खङ्गं तमाच्छिद्य महाकपिः। ननाद गिरिसंकाशस्त्रासयन्सर्वराक्षसान्॥
en: Then that mighty monkey-resembling a hill broke his sword as he fell, and roared, terrifying all the Raksasas.

sa: ततस्त्वेकजटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्। आमन्त्र्य क्रोधताम्राक्षी सीतां करतलोदरोम्॥
en: Thereupon another Rākṣasī named Ekjatä, with eyes rendered coppery with ire, addressing Sītā, having a small navel, said.

sa: सुग्रीवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता गन्तुं सर्वैश्च वानरैः। मम चापि प्रियं कार्यमयोध्यादर्शनेन च॥ प्रवेशं चैव रामस्य पौरजानपदैः सह। विभूतिं चैव सर्वासां स्त्रीणां दशरथस्य च॥
en: You have been ordered by Sugrīva to repair (to Ayodhyā) with the monkeys; to behold Ayodhyā, is also a dear object of mine. (“I shall behold) Rāma enter the city with the citizens and villagers and the wealth and riches of the wives of Dasaratha.

sa: अतिकायं हतं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना। उद्वेगमगमद्राजा वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing Atikāya slain by the high-souled Lakşmaņa, the king was filled with exceeding great anxiety and spoke thus.

sa: स महेश्वरसख्येन श्लाघमानस्त्वया विभो। निर्जितः समरे रोषाल्लोकपालो महाबलः॥
en: That mighty lord of men, proud of his friendship with Śiva, was defeated by you wrathfully in battle.

sa: तद् राजगुणसम्पन्नं मुख्यैश्च वरचन्दनैः। महाजनसमाकीर्णं सिंहैरिव महद् वनम्॥
en: That affluent with regal insignia and excellent sandals; crowded with mighty ones, like a vast forest with lions;

sa: दृष्ट्वा दाशरथिर्लङ्कां चित्रध्वजपताकिनीम्। जगाम मनसा सीतां दूयमानेन चेतसा॥
en: Beholding Lankā with variegated standards, and streamers, Dasaratha's son went* to Sītā with an aggrieved heart. *i.e. mentally.

sa: राममेवं ब्रुवाणं तु शोकव्याकुलितेन्द्रियम्॥ आश्वासयनुवाचेदं सुषेणः परमं वचः।
en: As Rāma was speaking thus with his senses overwhelmed with emotion, Sușeņa, soothing him, spoke these pregnant words.

sa: सुविभक्तमहाव्यूहा महावानररक्षिता। अनीकिनी सा विबभौ यथा द्यौः साभ्रसंप्लवा॥
en: That army being skilfully divided into parts and protected by great monkeys, resembled the welkin covered with clouds.

sa: त्रिषु चैतेषु यच्छेष्ठं श्रुत्वा तनावबुध्यते। राजा वा राजमात्रो वा व्यर्थं तस्य बहुश्रुतम्॥
en: But the king or the heir apparent, that, having heard what is prime among the three, does not understand, has his time in vain on his erudition.

sa: पुनश्च सृजते सर्वमनाद्यन्तं महेश्वरः। इष्टं चैव हि दत्तं च हुतं चैव निशाचर॥
en: And that lord of all gods again creates the universe without beginning or end. O night-ranger, he governs and preserves all sacrifices, gifts and oblations to fire.

sa: ततो विषण्णं समवेक्ष्यं सर्व विभीषणो बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठः। नाश्वासयन्त्रप्रतिमैर्वचोभिः॥
en: Thereupon, seeing them dispirited, that foremost of intelligent persons, Vibhisana, cheering them up with his peerless speech, said.

sa: यच्चैतच्चरितं दिव्यं कथा ते रघुनन्दन। तन्मयाप्सरसो राम श्रावयेयुर्नरर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of men, O descendant of Raghu, may the Apsarās make me always hear of your themes.

sa: स्वभावजरया युक्तं वृद्धं शरशतैश्चितम्। प्रजापतिसुतं वीरं शाम्यन्तमिव पावकम्॥ दृष्ट्वा समभिसंक्रम्य पौलस्त्यो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। कश्चिदार्यशरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्न प्राणा ध्वंसितास्तव ॥
en: Finding that heroic son of Prajāpati, afflicted with natural decrepitude, aged, and resembling smouldering fire, wounded with hundreds of shafts, Pulastya's son said, “O noble one, has not your life been destroyed with those sharp shafts?"

sa: अङ्गदेनात्र निहतो विकटो नाम राक्षसः। विरूपाक्षश्च दुष्प्रेक्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ।।।।
en: The Rākşasa named Vikața was slain there by Angada-and Virūpākșa, hard to look at and Mahāpārśva and Mahodara.

sa: नैव राजनि सुग्रीवे नाङ्गदे नापि राघवे। आर्य संदर्शितः स्नेहो यथा वायुसुते परः॥
en: O noble one, you did not show that overflowing affection either for king Sugrīva or Angada and Raghava that you show for the son of the wind-god.

sa: कुम्भकर्मोऽत्र निहतः प्रहस्तश्च निशाचरः। धूम्राक्षश्चात्र निहतो वानरेण हनूमता॥
en: Kumbhakarna was slain there, the night ranger Prahasta, as well, and Dumraksa, were slain by the monkey Hanuman.

sa: सेतुरत्र यथा बद्ध्येद्यथा पश्येम तां पुरीम्। तस्य राक्षसराजस्य तथा त्वं कुरु राघव॥
en: Do you, O Rāghava, so order matters that a bridge may be constructed (over the main), and that we may behold the palace of the Rākşasa monarch.

sa: अथ संचिन्त्य लङ्केशः सूर्यलोकं जगाम ह। मेरुशृङ्गे वरे रम्ये उषित्वा तत्र शर्वरीम्॥
en: Thereupon meditating for sometime the lord of Larikå went to the region of the sun and spent the night upon the picturesque summit of the mount Meru.

sa: तस्य तद्वचनाद्रक्षः सूर्यस्यान्तिकमागमत्। पिङ्गलं दण्डिनं चैव पश्यते द्वारपालको॥
en: Hearing those words that Rākșasa proceeded towards the sun and beheld two gate-keepers, Pingala and Dandī by name.

sa: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साधुभाषितम्॥ । पुनरप्यहमारू तामिदं वचनमब्रवम्। त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे॥ रामे दुःखाभिभूते च लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते।
en: Hearing those sweet and piteous accents of Vaidehi I again spoke to that worshipful dame, saying. 'Forsooth can I swear by you, O worshipful dame, that Rāma is sorely stricken with grief in your absence. And Lakšmaņa too relent heavily beholding him laden with sorrow.

sa: रावणस्य ततो रामो धनुर्मुक्तैः शितैः शरैः॥ चतुर्भिश्चतुरो दीप्तान्हयान्प्रत्यपसर्पयत्।
en: Rāma with four sharpened arrows shot off his bow, removed the flaming horses of Rāvana to some distance.

sa: अङ्गदे समनुप्राप्ते सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः॥ उवाच शोकसंतप्तं रामं कमललोचनम्।
en: And Angada nearing, Sugrīva, the lord of the monkeys, spoke to the lotus-eyed Rāma, stricken with grief, saying.

sa: अङ्गदो बहुभिश्छिन्नः शरैरासाद्य राक्षसैः। परितो रुधिरोद्गारी क्षितौ निपतितोऽङ्गदः॥
en: And torn by innumerable (arrows) discharged on all sides by Raksasas. Angada, vomiting blood, Leith on the ground.

sa: आकर्णकृष्टमुक्तेन जघान द्विविदं तदा। तेन हाटकपुनेन पत्रिणा पत्रवाससा॥
en: Then drawing his bow to its utmost bent, he hit Dvivida with a feathered shaft knobbed with gold.

sa: कथं पितुश्चाप्यधिको महाहवे शक्रस्य जेता हि कथं स राक्षसः। वराश्च लब्धाः कथयस्व मेऽद्य पाप्रच्छतश्चास्य मुनीन्द्र सर्वम्॥
en: How could that Raksasa, surpassing his sire, conquer Sakra in mighty encounter, and how did he obtain the boon? O foremost of anchorets, do you today unfold all this to me, who ask (for the same).

sa: रामेणाभिनिरस्तस्य संग्रामेऽस्मिन्सुदारुणे। भविष्यति न मे शोकः कुम्भकर्णे विबोधिते॥
en: I have been worsted in fierce fight by Rāma; but on Kumbhakarņa being awakened, my grief shall go.

sa: विभीषणस्तु संक्रुद्धो भ्रातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। श्रूयतामस्य पापस्य कर्मणः फलमागतम्॥
en: Worked up with ire Vibhîşana said to his brother: "Hear, the fruit of your vicious actions has arrived.

sa: ततः कुम्भस्तु सुग्रीवं बाहुभ्यां जगृहे तदा। गजाविवावीतमदौ निःश्वसन्तौ मुहुर्मुहुः॥ अन्योन्यगात्रग्रथितौ घर्षन्तावितरेतरम्। सधूमां मुखतो ज्वालां विसृजन्तौ परिश्रमात्॥
en: Then Kumbha seized Sugriva by the arms. And like two elephants in rut, they sighing momentarily, fastened on each other's person, and possessed each other, and from fatigue emitting from their mouth flames mixed with vapour.

sa: अङ्गदेनात्र निहतो विकटो नाम राक्षसः। विरूपाक्षश्च दुष्प्रेक्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ।।।।
en: The Rākşasa named Vikața was slain there by Angada-and Virūpākșa, hard to look at and Mahāpārśva and Mahodara.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा दशग्रीवो राक्षसप्रतिवेदितम्। अशोकवनिकां त्यक्त्वा मन्त्रिणां दर्शनं ययौ॥
en: Hearing these words of the Rākşasa, the Tennecked one, leaving the Asoka wood, went to see the counsellors.

sa: प्रवाति पवनस्तस्मिन्सपांसुः खरदारुणः। निर्याणे तस्य रौद्रस्य मकराक्षस्य दुर्मते॥
en: There blew a terribly rough wind mixed with dust when the fearfully wicked-minded Makaraksa's issued out for battle.

sa: तैरश्वैर्धाम्यते भ्रान्तैः सुमाली राक्षसेश्वरः। इन्द्रियाश्वैः परिभ्रान्तैधृतिहीनो यथा नरः॥
en: And with his bewildered steeds Sumali wanders like a person deprived of patience, whose senses are under hallucination.

sa: ऋक्षाणां वानराणां च राक्षसानां च सर्वशः। वृन्दान्युत्सार्यमाणानि दूरमुत्तस्थुरन्ततः॥
en: The crowds of bears, monkeys and Rākṣasas being driven on all sides began to fly at a distance.

sa: एवमास्ते महाभागा सीता शोकपरायणा। यदत्र प्रतिकर्तव्यं तत् सर्वमुपकल्प्यताम्॥
en: Thus live there the great Sītă worn out with grief. Do you now perform what you think proper.

sa: कुम्भकर्मोऽत्र निहतः प्रहस्तश्च निशाचरः। धूम्राक्षश्चात्र निहतो वानरेण हनूमता॥
en: Kumbhakarna was slain there, the night ranger Prahasta, as well, and Dumraksa, were slain by the monkey Hanuman.

sa: ततो विष्णुं महाबाहुं प्रपतन्तं रणाजिरे। हते सुमालेर वैश्च रथे विष्णुरथं प्रति। माली चाभ्यद्रवधुक्तः प्रगुम स शरासनम्॥
en: And on Sumali's car being drawn at random by his steeds, Mali, taking his bow and equipped therewith, darted at Vişnu's car and assailed that mighty-armed one as he was descending on the field of fight.

sa: शैलांश्च तरुसंछन्नान् वनराजीश्च पुष्पिताः। अभिचक्राम तेजस्वी हनूमान् प्लवगर्षभः॥
en: That foremost of monkeys, the energetic Hanumān, went by hills filled with trees, and ranges of blossoming woods.

sa: दण्डनिर्घातवादिन्याः श्रुत्वा भेर्या महास्वनम्। उवाच सरमा सीतामिदं मधुरभाषिणी॥
en: Hearing the mighty sounds of kettledrums produced by sticks struck (thereon), the honeytongued Saramā spoke thus to Sītā.

sa: सुतस्य यदि मे भार्या ततस्त्वं हि स्नषा भवेः। बाढमित्येव सा रम्भा प्राह रावणमुत्तरम्॥ धर्मतस्ते सुतस्याहं भार्या राक्षसपुङ्गव। पुत्रः प्रियतरः प्राणैर्धातुर्वैश्रवणस्य ते॥ विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु नलकूबर इत्ययम्। धर्मतो यो भवेद्विप्रः क्षत्रियो वीर्यतो भवेत्॥ क्रोधाद्यश्च भवेदग्निः क्षान्त्या च वसुधासमः। तस्यास्मि कृतसंकेता लोकपालसुतस्य वै॥
en: “Had you been the wife of my son, you would have been my daughter-in-law.” Whereto Rambha replied. “Truly it is; I am, by virtue, the wife of your son, O foremost of Raksasas. Your brother Vaiśravana has a son, dearer than his life, celebrated in the three worlds under the name of Nalkūbara. In virtue he is like to a Brahmin, in prowess he equals a Kşatriya, in anger he is very fire and in patience he is like the earth. I have been thus directed by that Lokapāla's son.

sa: तत्र विघ्नं तु तस्येह कर्तुं नार्हसि मुञ्च माम्। सद्भिराचरितं मागं गच्छ राक्षसपुङ्गव॥
en: You should not put obstacle in that; it behove you to let me go; do you, O foremost of Rāksasas, wend the way treaded by the pious.

sa: मन्त्रिपुत्रान् हताश्रुत्वा समरे लघुविक्रमान्। पञ्च सेनाग्रगाञ्छूरान् प्रेषयामास रावणः॥
en: Hearing of the destruction in battle of the ministers' sons of feeble prowess Rāvana sent five heroic commanders,

sa: एवं त्वमपराधं मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि सुव्रतः॥ नहि तुल्यं बलं सौम्य स्त्रियाश्च पुरुषस्य हि।
en: O you of firm vows, it behove you to forgive me for this folly. O gentle one, a woman's strength can never equal that of a man.

sa: दृष्ट्वा सर्वे महात्मानस्ततस्ते वानरर्षभाः। विसृष्टाः पार्थिवेन्द्रेण किष्किन्धां समुपागमन्॥
en: Beholding (the installation of Rāma) the highsouled monkeys, taking leave of the lord of earth, went to Kiskindha.

sa: बाढमित्येव तां वाणी प्रत्यगृह्णामहं ततः। आस्यप्रमाणादधिकं तस्याः कायमपूरयम्॥
en: Saying, Well,' I accepted her speech, increasing my body at will more than the capacity or her mouth;

sa: एतन्मुहूर्तमेवाहं तस्यैतस्य तु वै कृते। चतुरो लोकपालांस्तानयिष्यामि यमक्षयम्॥
en: On his account solely I shall on the instant despatch the four Lokapālas to the abode of Death.

sa: प्रत्यक्षमेव भवतां महेन्द्राग्रात् खमाप्लुतः। उदधेर्दक्षिणं पारं काङ्क्षमाणः समाहितः॥
en: In your sight, I bounded up with concentrated mind, eager to reach the southern shore of the ocean.

sa: समरे युध्यमानानामस्माकं प्रेक्षतां च सः। जघान रुदती सीतामिन्द्रजिद्रावणात्मजः॥
en: As we were fighting the field, Ravana's son, Indrajit in our very sight slew Sītā, crying (in distress).

sa: ततः शक्तिं महाशक्तिः प्रदीप्तामशनीमिव। विभीषणाय चिक्षेप राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: The powerful lord of Raksasas endowed with immense strength, hurled at Vibhīşaņa a dart resembling the flaming thunder-bolt.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे राक्षसान्युद्धकाङ्गिणः। मुमुचुर्विविधान्नादांस्तस्य रामस्य पश्यतः॥
en: On seeing the Rākşasas, the monkeys burning for battle set up various roars in the presence of Rama.

sa: समसौम्यानि रम्याणि विशालान्यायतानि च। दृष्टिरम्याणि ते दृष्ट्वा बभूवुर्जातविस्मयः॥
en: Seeing those extensive (woods and forests), mild, and charming, and beautiful to behold, they were seized with wonderment.

sa: रत्नकुम्भेन महता शीतं मारुतविक्रमः। उत्तराच्च जलं शीघ्रं गरुडानिलविक्रमः॥ आजहार स धर्मात्मानिलः सर्वगुणान्वितः।
en: The virtuous-souled Wind-gods son, gifted with all accomplishments and the prowess of Garuda and Wind-god, brought, speedily from the Northern Ocean, water in that large jewelled jar.

sa: ततोऽमन्यद्विस्तीर्णं गत्वा तस्य गिरेस्तटम्। तूष्णीं वर्षशतान्यष्टौ ममवारं महाव्रतम्॥
en: Then I, going to another spacious peak of the inountain, became engaged in silently observing a mighty vow.

sa: नहि धर्मविरुद्धेषु बह्वपायेषु कर्मसु। मूलघातिषु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवद्विधाः॥
en: Actions opposed to righteousness, and bringing on countless evils, and causing extermination, ill become persons of your sort.

sa: प्रिये त्वं सह नारीणां वानराणां महात्मनाम्। राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता मैथिलीप्रियकाम्यया॥ त्वर त्वमभिगच्छामो गृह्य वानरयोषितः। अयोध्यां दर्शयिष्यामः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः॥
en: O dear, at the command of Rāghava and the kind desire of Sītā, do you soon go, taking with you the wives of all the high-souled monkeys. We shall see Ayodhyā and the wives of Dasaratha.

sa: महता हरिसैन्येन सवेगमभिसंवृतः। ऋक्षराजबलं चैव ददर्श पथि विष्ठितम्॥
en: And strongly encompassed by that mighty monkey-host, (Laksmana) saw the forces of the bear-king stationed on the way.

sa: सुग्रीवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता गन्तुं सर्वैश्च वानरैः। मम चापि प्रियं कार्यमयोध्यादर्शनेन च॥ प्रवेशं चैव रामस्य पौरजानपदैः सह। विभूतिं चैव सर्वासां स्त्रीणां दशरथस्य च॥
en: You have been ordered by Sugrīva to repair (to Ayodhyā) with the monkeys; to behold Ayodhyā, is also a dear object of mine. (“I shall behold) Rāma enter the city with the citizens and villagers and the wealth and riches of the wives of Dasaratha.

sa: हते प्रहस्ते नीलेन तदकम्प्यं महाबलम्। राक्षसानामहृष्टाना लङ्कामभिजगाम हा५६।।
en: On Prahasta being slain by Nila, that mighty army of Raksasas never trembling (from fear). retreated towards Larikā.

sa: प्रभग्नं समरे दृष्ट्वा वानराणां महाबलम्। अभिदुद्राव सुग्रीवो महोदरमनन्तरम्॥
en: And beholding his powerful monkeys force thus assailed in the conflict, Sugrīva dashed for ward and fronted Mahodara.

sa: तं विरूपाक्षयूपक्षौ दृष्ट्वा निपतितं भुवि। तौ जातरोषौ दुर्धर्षावुत्पेततुररिन्दमौ॥
en: Seeing him down on the earth, those irrepressible subduers of enemies, Virūpaksa and Yupaksa, waxing wroth, sprang up.

sa: अमात्यैर्ब्राह्मणैश्चैव तथा प्रकृतिभिर्वृतः। श्रिया विरुरुचे रामो नक्षत्रैरिव चन्द्रमाः॥
en: And surrounded by his courtiers, Brāhmaṇas and subjects Rāma appeared beautiful like to the Moon encircled by stars.

sa: सं समीक्ष्यैव ते सर्वे दिक्षु सर्वास्ववस्थिताः॥ तैस्तैः प्रहरणैर्भीमैरभिपेतुस्ततस्ततः।
en: And soon as they saw him, they, frightened at his appearance, assailed him with their respective terrible weapons.

sa: शङ्खशब्दप्रणादैश्च दुन्दुभीनां च निःस्वनैः। प्रययौ पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तां पुरीं हर्नामालिनीम्॥
en: And with the music of conches and bugles that foremost of men entered the city abounding in houses.

sa: अर्घमानस्ततस्तेन दुर्धरणानिलात्मजः। चकार निनदं भूयो व्यवर्धत च वीर्यवान्॥
en: And sore beset by Durdhara, the Wind-god's son again emitted cries, and that puissant one also increased himself.

sa: स चिन्तयित्वा सुचिरं धैर्यमालम्ब्य रावणः। राघवं हरियूथांश्च ददर्शायतलोचनः॥
en: And reflecting for long, Rāvana having expansive eyes, Assuming patience, gazed at Rāghava and the leader of monkeys.

sa: दृष्ट्वा दाशरथिर्लङ्कां चित्रध्वजपताकिनीम्। जगाम मनसा सीतां दूयमानेन चेतसा॥
en: Dasaratha's son, seeing Lankā crowned with variegated ensigns and standards, mentally went to Sītā, with a sad heart.

sa: ततश्चक्राणि निष्पेतु स्वराणि महान्ति च। कार्मुकाद्भीमवेगस्य दशग्रीवस्य धीमतः।७।।
en: Thereupon from the bow of the wondrous vehement and intelligent Ten-necked one rushed out discuses flaming and mighty.

sa: स तं परिघमादाय जघान रजनीचरान्। सपन्नगमिवादाय स्फुरन्तं विनतासुतः॥
en: And taking that bolt, like Vinatā's offspring handing a darting serpent, he slew those rangers of the night.

sa: तस्य वीर्यवतः कच्चिद् यद्यस्ति मयि सम्भ्रमः। किमर्थं न शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षयं नयति राक्षसान्॥
en: If that puissant one still retains any regard for me, why dose he not by means of sharpened shafts make roots and branch work with the Raksasas?

sa: प्रविष्टोऽस्मि हि ते वक्त्रं दाक्षायणि नमोऽस्तु ते। गमिष्ये यत्र वैदेही सत्यश्चासीद् वरस्तव॥
en: O descendant of Dakşa, I have entered into your mouth. I bow down to you. I will repair to where Vaidehi is Your boon has proved trve.

sa: हन्तुकामस्य मे बाष्पं चक्षुश्चैव निरुध्यति। तमेवैष महाबाहुर्लक्ष्मणः शमयिष्यति॥
en: Tears surcharge the eyes of me who seek to slay him. Let therefore Lakşmaņa administer him his quietus.

sa: यदि नोत्सहसे यातुं मया सार्धमनिन्दिते। अभिज्ञानं प्रयच्छ त्वं जानीयाद् राघवो हि यत्॥
en: If you do not wish to go with me, O you of a blameless person, do you give me such a token as might create Rāghava's confidence.

sa: स दत्त्वा तुमुलं युद्धं पितृव्यस्येन्द्रजिद्बली॥ लक्ष्मणं परवीरघ्नः पुनरेवाभ्यधावत।
en: And fighting a furious fight with his uncle, the powerful Indrajit, slayer of hostile heroesagain rushed against Lakşmaņa.

sa: ततस्तमभिदुद्राव राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम्। पुरा हि मनुचिं संख्ये वज्रेणेव पुरंदरः॥
en: As of yore Purandara had in encounter pursued Namuchi with the thunder-bolt, (Hanuman) pursued that best of RāksasasAkampana.

sa: सपर्वतवनोद्देशां साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम्। लङ्कामिमां सनाथां वा नयितुं शक्तिरस्ति मे॥
en: I am capable of carrying this Lankā with her lord, the mountains, forests gardens, buildings, walls and gate-ways.

sa: स तस्मात् पादपाद् धीमानाप्लुत्य प्लवगर्षभः। ततो वर्धितुमारेभे सीताप्रत्ययकारणात्॥
en: And leaping down from the tree, that best of monkeys began to increase himself to create Sītā's confidence.

sa: एतत्ते सकलं राज्यं न्यासं निर्यातितं मया॥ अद्य जन्म कृतार्थं मे संवृत्तश्च मनोरथः। यत्त्वां पश्यामि राजानमयोध्यां पुनरागतम्॥
en: This all your kingdom, which you did leave to my care, I return you. Blessed is my birth today and accomplished is my desire, since I behold you again as king in Ayodhyā after your return.

sa: रावणिश्चापि संक्रुद्धो रणे वानरयूथपान्॥ पातयामास बाणौषैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: And Ravana's son, waxing furious, in that contest began to bring down monkeys by hundreds and by thousands.

sa: ततः शोणितदिग्धाङ्गो लक्ष्मणेन्द्रजितावुभौ। रणे तौ रेजतुर्वीरौ पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: Both Lakşmaņa and Indrajit, with their persons bathed in blood in that encounter, appeared like to flowering Kinsukas.

sa: हरीनेव सुसंरुष्टा हरयो जघ्नुराहवे॥ राक्षसा राक्षसांश्चापि निजघ्नुस्तिमिरे तदा।
en: In that conflict in the dark then monkeys extremely enraged slew monkeys, and Räkşasas also killed the Rākşasas.

sa: राघवौ पतितौ दृष्ट्वा शरजालसमन्वितौ। बभूवुर्व्यथिताः सर्वे वानराः सविभीषणाः।७॥
en: Seeing the sons of Raghu lying, covered with showers of shafts, the monkeys, with Vibhisana, were pained (exceedingly).

sa: स श्रुत्वा वानरेन्द्रस्तु लक्ष्मणेनेरितं वचः॥ तदासीनिष्प्रभोऽत्यर्थं ग्रहग्रस्त इवांशुमान्।
en: And hearing Laksmana's words, the lord of monkeys became pale, like to the radiant Sun possessed by Rāhu.

sa: तासां मध्ये महाबाहुः शुशुभे राक्षसेश्वरः। गोष्ठे महति मुख्यानां गवां मध्ये यथा वृषः॥
en: In the midst of them all, the lord of the Rāks asas looked splendid like an ox in a spacious stall in the midst of stately kine.

sa: तद्राक्षसतनूजस्य भिन्नस्कन्धं शिरो महत्। तपनीयनिभं भूमौ ददृशे रुधिरोक्षितम्॥
en: The mighty severed head of the Rākşasas son, resembling one made of gold, was seen covered with blood.

sa: अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रः सुग्रीवं वानरर्षभम्। परिष्वज्य महातेजा भरतो धर्मिणां वरः॥
en: Then embracing Sugrīva, the foremost of monkeys, the highly effulgent prince Bharata, the foremost of the pious, said.

sa: शीघ्रं निर्यान्तु दुर्धर्षा राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः। अकम्पनं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रकोविदम्॥
en: Let invincible Rākşasas of dreadful prowess, march forth, placing before them Akampana, skilled in all weapons and arms.

sa: सुमाली सचिवैः सार्धं वृतो राक्षसपुङ्गवैः। अभिगम्य दशग्रीवं परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Accompanied by his counsellors-foremost of Rākşasas-Sumāli presenting himself before the Ten-necked one and embracing him, addressed him, saying.

sa: ततोऽन्यच्छिखरं गृह्य विपुलं दुमभूषितम्। वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य शिरसि पातयामास वानरः॥
en: Then the the monkey, taking up another prodigious peak crowned with trees, let it alight on Varradanstra's head.

sa: अङ्गदेन शिला क्षिप्ता गत्वा तु रणमूर्धनि । सचक्रकूबरं साश्वं प्रममाथ रथं तदा॥
en: The crag discharged by Angada, coursing on in the field, dashed to pieces the car along with the wheels and the Kuvara as well as the horses.

sa: स निर्यातो महावीर्यो धूम्राक्षो राक्षसैर्वृतः। हसन्वै पश्चिमद्वाराद्धनूमान्यत्र तिष्ठति॥
en: The highly powerful Dhūmrākşa, surrounded by Rākşasas, cheerfully issued out of the Western Entrance, where Hanumān was posted.

sa: भर्तारमनवद्याङ्गी लक्ष्मणं चासितेक्षणा। प्रेक्ष्य पांसुषु चेष्टन्तौ रुरोद जनकात्मजा॥
en: That black-eyed one of an excellent person, Janaka's daughter-seeing them roll in the dust, broke out into lamentation.

sa: स्तनौ चाविरलौ पीनौ मामको मग्नचूचुकौ। मग्ना चोत्सेधनी नाभिः पार्थोरस्कं च मे चितम्॥
en: And my breasts are close and firm and developed, and have their nipples sunk. And my navel is depressed, with high sides. And my chest is swelling.
